answer: Random-pair heartbeat bonds: each epoch a chain beacon draws random pairs and opens a 10-minute window. Both agents post 50 POA into an escrow vault and countersign each other's signed heartbeat before it closes. Miss once and both bonds slash; survivors get re-paired next epoch. A sybil farm with 1,000 fakes locks 50,000 POA and must reply for every fake live. Random partners mean no batching and no shared hardware. A missed pulse burns 50 POA per pair; hundreds of fakes mean hundreds of burns. Re-pairing sweeps through like a zephyr, and one loose thread unravels the whole weave.
